headline: RKEC Projects board meets to review corporate matters
hook: Routine board meeting update from RKEC

modes.bear: Standard board outcomes without major growth disclosures offer little immediate upside catalyst.

headline: RKEC Projects submits latest shareholding pattern to NSE
